topics.topic: Whether check_value_forms should derive the permitted failure kind and test expectation solely from FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS, without an inline refusal-kind subset
questions: Remove the inline OUTSIDE_FORM/OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member subset and let the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant alone supply the permitted mapping.
Remove the inline OUTSIDE_FORM/OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member subset and require the test to expect the member selected by the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant.
Remove the inline two-member subset and state only that the failure kind is the member of = models.RefusalKind whose value the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant maps the field value to.
Remove the inline two-member subset and require the test to expect the member of = models.RefusalKind selected through the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant.
Remove the inline OUTSIDE_FORM/OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST subset and require the failure kind solely through the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant.
Remove the inline OUTSIDE_FORM/OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST subset and state that the test expects the member selected through the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant.

quotes: check_value_forms: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST answer one RefusalFailure, carrying the value's path, for every form value outside its form and none for the others, in the order of form_values, each value's form chosen by its field of = models.FormField and each failure's kind the member of = models.RefusalKind, the OUTSIDE_FORM member or the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member, whose value the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant maps the value of that field to: a value of the ALIAS member of = models.FormField longer than the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant counted in Unicode code points, one of the FLOOR_AREA member of = models.FormField for which _read_decimal_text answers None or whose Decimal is not greater than the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant, one of the ROOMS_COUNT member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None or whose integer is less than the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant, one of the FLOOR member of = models.FormField for which _read_whole_number_text answers None, one of the OBJECT_KIND member of = models.FormField outside = models.ObjectKind, one of the CUSTOMER_LANGUAGE member of = models.FormField outside = models.CustomerLanguage or one of the CUSTOMER_KIND member of = models.CustomerKind.

check_value_forms: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show, at each bound and one step past it, that an alias of exactly the imported ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS constant in Unicode code points passes and one code point more is refused, characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane counted as one; a number of rooms equal to the imported OBJECT_ROOMS_MIN constant passes while one below it and one with a fraction are each refused; a floor area equal to the imported OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE constant or below it is refused and a floor area above it passes, its Decimal kept exactly as written; a negative whole floor passes and a floor with a fraction is refused; an object kind outside = models.ObjectKind, a customer language outside = models.CustomerLanguage and a customer kind outside = models.CustomerKind are refused; each refusal's kind is the member of = models.RefusalKind, the OUTSIDE_FORM member or the OUTSIDE_CLOSED_LIST member, whose value the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant maps the value of its field to; several values outside their form are all answered together, each with its path.
judgement.why: Both notes state an inline two-member allow-list even though the failure-kind mapping is already supplied through the imported FORM_FIELD_REFUSAL_KINDS constant.
judgement.rule: подмножество членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
